CustomField.label: Account Manager
CustomField.description:
★R8 SEIM_INVITEE.ACCT_MNGR — the AM who owns the customer this guest belongs to, snapshotted from Account.OwnerId at add time.
Not the same person as Added_By__c, and conflating the two would be the easy mistake: Added_By__c is whoever put this row on the list, which is often somebody else entirely. This one is the relationship owner, and it is the person requirement.md meant by "送出給 Account Owner" before R3 turned that phrase into a proxy for the submitter's manager. R5 deleted the field this rung needed; R8 has it back through the Contact link, so the control R5 gave up — the customer's owner sees who is being invited to their customer — is available again without violating the premise that an Account is only ever a real transacting customer.
Frozen at add time rather than read live, for the same reason Approver__c is frozen at submit time: an account changing hands mid-approval must not silently move the decision to somebody who has not seen it. Blank where the guest has no Account.
